accepted_findings.evidence: v1 versus implemented v1.1 conflict is real; v1.2 must be a successor and prior evidence cannot be relabeled.
accepted_findings.required_change: Preserve successor version and explicit compatibility witness.
accepted_findings.discriminating_witness: v1.1 plus authoritative inputs migrates to a separately identified v1.2 artifact; relabel-only fails.

accepted_findings.evidence: Both analysts converge on one semantic owner, reference-first interactive consumers, and validated detached snapshots.
accepted_findings.required_change: Keep RelationFacet as an index role over existing scene bindings.
accepted_findings.discriminating_witness: No independently writable or serialized second facet record exists.

accepted_findings.evidence: Typed missing, stale, collision, and projection-collapse failures prohibit tuple fallback.
accepted_findings.required_change: Preserve exact-ID fail-closed resolution for every consumer.
accepted_findings.discriminating_witness: Parallel same-tuple relations remain separate and missing one never selects its sibling.

accepted_findings.evidence: The downstream chain, owned runner, static envelope, and Body War denominator transition are unresolved implementation work.
accepted_findings.required_change: Carry these conditions into the repair plan without runtime claims.
accepted_findings.discriminating_witness: The later package binds a runner, baseline, and consumer-specific negative tests.

refuted_findings.evidence: The selected facet is only Readonly<SourceRelationBinding> indexed over existing partition objects, not a new payload type.
refuted_findings.required_change: Clarify that candidate C names revision/index behavior, not a second semantic record.

refuted_findings.evidence: ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION is a bare-Node command-shape failure, not a product regression.
refuted_findings.required_change: Bind the repository-owned loader in the plan.
refuted_findings.discriminating_witness: The same corpus runs through the owned loader.

new_findings.evidence: The original schema described a single-reference envelope rather than the actual successor scene composition.
new_findings.required_change: Define KnowledgeScene v1.2 composition and reusable relation definitions separately.
new_findings.discriminating_witness: A complete v1.2 scene validates; a standalone reference cannot masquerade as a scene.

new_findings.evidence: The original snapshot prohibited endpoint labels/traversal phrase and required color/pattern, contradicting self-contained fallback.
new_findings.required_change: Add endpoint/traversal text and allow absent display encodings.
new_findings.discriminating_witness: Reverse traversal remains understandable with null color and pattern; drift rejects.

new_findings.evidence: Digest fields existed without normative canonical inputs, ordering, domain separation, count equality, or back-reference rules.
new_findings.required_change: Specify the complete digest profile and validator ownership.
new_findings.discriminating_witness: Partition reorder is stable; semantic mutation changes digests; count/order/domain substitution rejects.

new_findings.evidence: A legacy scene cannot prove its copied bindings still match SourceGraph by recomputing only itself.
new_findings.required_change: Bind migration to exact SourceGraph and ViewPack evidence and compare all bindings.
new_findings.discriminating_witness: Matching authoritative inputs migrate; a drifted legacy binding rejects.

fix_before_plan_admission: bind migration to authoritative source evidence

stop_conditions: Do not resume SWU-UOVA-004 until v1.2 schema and compatibility witness agree.
Do not accept static output until endpoint, traversal, missing-encoding, and drift witnesses pass.
Do not accept copied view fields until digest canonicalization and negative tests exist.
Do not claim Body War acceptance until one authoritative denominator baseline is selected.
Do not claim runtime, browser, accessibility, release, or production readiness.
claim_ceiling: Read-only adversarial design evidence; four repairs required and no implementation or runtime behavior proven.
